say:5:1711155003:0.text: Deergray was a madman, but his research in this area has inspired you.
say:5:1711155003:0.source_cn: 迪尔格雷是个疯子，但他在这方面的研究也启发了你。

say:9:1711155006:1.text: Merlin, the Mage... Kirsty the Magician...
say:9:1711155006:1.source_cn: 梅、梅林阁下……科丝蒂魔法师……

say:10:1711155007:1.text: I have revealed to you all of Deer Grey's most crucial secrets without reservation!
say:10:1711155007:1.source_cn: 我、我已经毫无保留地将迪尔格雷最核心的机密都展示给你们了！

say:18:1711155012:0.text: Praise be to Aya… Praise be to your boundless mercy, Lord Merlin…
say:18:1711155012:0.source_cn: 赞美艾雅……赞美您宽宏大量的慈悲，梅林阁下……
